correctness.rationale: For the exact Gallo–Videla brackets, the Kirillov form has an odd-dimensional alternating noncentral block and central W, so rank is at most 2n-2. With path coordinates all 1, D^T imposes x3=0, x_{n-2}=0, x_i=x_{i+3}; its rank is n-1 except n mod 3 = 2, when its left kernel is 2-dimensional. One edge coefficient makes the induced alternating form on that kernel nondegenerate. This yields a rank 2n-2 witness and the explicit radical over every field, with n=2 treated directly. Replayed independent matrix-unit bracket construction checked 68 witnesses and 13,382 exhaustive small-field forms; neither finite census nor logs replace the proof.

value.rationale: The Lie index is a standard coadjoint-orbit invariant. The theorem computes it uniformly across the natural path family in a newly defined class-three graph construction and in every characteristic; it also explains the nontrivial mod-three deficiency of the mixed bracket and gives an explicit stabilizer that moves from vertex grading to edge grading. This all-length structural profile is more than a small numerical calculation or a mere transcription of center dimensions.
